clarity.notes: UI-kit, Product Patterns, 12-state screen contract and the connected GIS flow now explain one model from foundations through recovery paths.

hierarchy.notes: The workspace preserves structure → map → inspector. Responsive transforms prevent all three regions competing for width, while selected echelon, object, warnings and save state remain explicit.

typography.notes: Documentation copy, specifications, toolbar labels and compact data retain readable floors. IBM Plex Sans/Mono remain the contract; actual application font loading is not verified.

motion.notes: 140/200 ms motion, reduced-motion overrides, focus traps, Escape and focus restoration are implemented in the prototype. Equivalence in the production React overlay provider is not verified.

brand.notes: The approved cold neutral scale, blue action accent, light analytical panels and contextual dark map are retained without a new visual direction or screen-local exceptions.

verification.notes: Standalone prototype paths and static contracts were checked. This is not a claim of full WCAG conformance or production React DOM equivalence.

closedRisks: Side navigation collapses below 1280 CSS px.
ObjectInspector becomes an accessible drawer below 1280 CSS px.
ProjectTree becomes a drawer below 1024 CSS px, leaving map and inspector out of width competition.
The system-state simulator is outside the product surface.
All 12 required screen states share one screen model and explicit transitions.
Selection, save, warning, conflict, offline and recovery paths have keyboard, focus and live-region contracts.
The missing semantic overlay backdrop role was added through primitive, semantic and component token layers.
openRisks: Focus trap, Escape, focus restoration and announcements require tests in the production React DOM and supported assistive technologies.
IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono loading and fallback behavior are not verified in the frontend runtime.
Lucide and Ant Icons coexist in frontend; the migration boundary and domain icon ownership require a team decision.
The production overlay provider and z-index integration are not verified.
Offline persistence, reconnection semantics, validation thresholds and backend conflict payloads are product assumptions, not frontend-confirmed APIs.
Real browser 200% zoom, high-contrast modes and screen-reader behavior require runtime acceptance testing.
